caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned prominently in the center of the page. The jug has a rounded body that tapers into a narrow neck with a small lip at the top, and it features a curved handle that connects the neck and upper shoulder. The body of the jug is predominantly grayish with subtle brownish and reddish tinges in some areas, notably towards the lower front. There are blue decorative accents painted on the upper shoulder and around the handle. The background is plain, and a thin rectangular border frames the primary jug illustration. In the upper right corner, within its own smaller rectangular frame, there is a detail drawing showing the top of the jug, highlighting the blue design and the texture of the surface. The artist's name, "N. Amantea," is written at the lower right corner of the main frame.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
